name: @cyberbaser/projection
description: The vault projection: copies the published set into a renderer-agnostic content tree at verbatim paths (no lowercasing, no renames — R16), and fails the build on bad frontmatter, case collisions or a boundary leak. Lowercasing and the natural-case alias injection that goes with it are implemented but off by default, deferred to projection v2. Knows nothing about any renderer.
